wargear.name: Iron Hand graft
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A fist and forearm of black-iron servos, grafted on in a ritual of surrender. The model gains +1 Strength and loses 1 Initiative.

wargear.name: Fortress-shield array
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Interlocked shield plates and a gyro-stabilised brace turn the squad into a moving bulkhead. Every model in the unit has a 4+ Invulnerable Save if it was worse.

wargear.name: Pain-engine harness
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A cortex-fed servitor harness that turns every wound into fuel for the next blow. The model gains +1 Attack and loses 1 Initiative.

wargear.name: Clan iron-cladding
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Layer upon layer of clan-forged plating bolted over the sarcophagus. The model gains +1 Wound.

option.text: The Sergeant may take a clan-forged weapon
The Sergeant may take an Iron Hand graft
The unit may carry a Fortress-shield array
Any Castellax may exchange its mauler bolt cannon for
Any Morlock may exchange its combi-bolter for
May be fitted with Clan iron-cladding

modifiers.text: Flesh long since replaced: +1 T, -1 I.

rules.name: Cortex-Locked
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Cohorts of the Iron Father). A unit with this rule automatically passes Morale Checks and Checks to avoid Tactical Statuses caused by casualties, while an Iron Father is on the table.

rules.name: Unyielding Wall
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Wall of Black Iron). A unit with this rule gains Feel No Pain (6+) in any turn in which it did not move.

rules.name: Hammerfall
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Gorgon's Hammer). On the turn a unit with this rule charges it adds +1 Strength. If it destroys the enemy unit it charged, it may make a free move of up to 3" afterwards.

rites.name: Cohorts of the Iron Father
rites.flavor: A Clan-Council that trusts steel and cortex-code over the whims of flesh.
benefits: Castellax Battle Maniples and Castellax Destructor Maniples may fill Troops slots.
Every Castellax gains +1 Ballistic Skill and Cortex-Locked: it passes Morale Checks automatically while an Iron Father is on the table.
limitations: An Iron Father (either pattern) must be in the army.
No more than two Tactical or Despoiler Squads in total.
No Librarians or Esoterists, no Assault Squads, and no model with the Antigrav type.

modifiers.text: Cohorts of the Iron Father: +1 BS, Cortex-Locked.

require.note: An Iron Father must command the cohorts.

rites.name: Wall of Black Iron
rites.flavor: Nothing in the Legion is built to retreat, and the Immortals least of all.
benefits: Gorgon Terminator Squads may fill Troops slots.
Medusan Immortals Squads gain Line (1) and Unyielding Wall: Feel No Pain (6+) in any turn they did not move.
limitations: At least two Medusan Immortals Squads are required.
No Fast Attack units and no Recon units.

modifiers.text: Wall of Black Iron: Line (1), Unyielding Wall.

require.note: Bring at least two Medusan Immortals Squads.

rites.name: The Gorgon's Hammer
rites.flavor: When the clan-lords stop talking, the Gorgons go in.
benefits: Gorgon Terminator Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Hammerfall: +1 Strength on a turn they charge, and a free 3" move after destroying the unit they charged.
limitations: At least two Gorgon Terminator Squads are required.
No Armour units and no Recon units.

modifiers.condition: on a turn the unit charges

require.note: Bring at least two Gorgon Terminator Squads.
